payg.note: Upgrading to a paid tier forfeits the free-tier command allowance; the full monthly command volume is billed at this rate, with no carry-over credit.

fixed_plans.name: fixed_250mb
fixed_plans.note: commands effectively unlimited within fair-use; bounded by storage/bandwidth, not command count

selection_note: Fixed plans are priced by storage footprint, not command volume, so they are cheaper than PAYG for any steady, high-command workload that fits the storage tier. PAYG is preferable for bursty or idle-heavy workloads. The engine computes min(PAYG, best-fit Fixed) subject to a storage_mb estimate supplied by the workload config.
